legend: Emuskald considers himself a master of flow algorithms. Now he has completed his most ingenious program yet — it calculates the maximum flow in an undirected graph. The graph consists of n vertices and m edges. Vertices are numbered from 1 to n. Vertices 1 and n being the source and the sink respectively.

However, his max-flow algorithm seems to have a little flaw — it only finds the flow volume for each edge, but not its direction. Help him find for each edge the direction of the flow through this edges. Note, that the resulting flow should be correct maximum flow.
More formally. You are given an undirected graph. For each it's undirected edge (ai, bi) you are given the flow volume ci. You should direct all edges in such way that the following conditions hold:
for each vertex v (1 < v < n), sum of ci of incoming edges is equal to the sum of ci of outcoming edges;
vertex with number 1 has no incoming edges;
the obtained directed graph does not have cycles.
input: The first line of input contains two space-separated integers n and m (2 ≤ n ≤ 2·105, n - 1 ≤ m ≤ 2·105), the number of vertices and edges in the graph. The following m lines contain three space-separated integers ai, bi and ci (1 ≤ ai, bi ≤ n, ai ≠ bi, 1 ≤ ci ≤ 104), which means that there is an undirected edge from ai to bi with flow volume ci.
It is guaranteed that there are no two edges connecting the same vertices; the given graph is connected; a solution always exists.
output: Output m lines, each containing one integer di, which should be 0 if the direction of the i-th edge is ai → bi (the flow goes from vertex ai to vertex bi) and should be 1 otherwise. The edges are numbered from 1 to m in the order they are given in the input.
If there are several solutions you can print any of them.
note: In the first test case, 10 flow units pass through path ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/609340f155794c4e9eebcd9cdfa23c73cf982f28.png), and 5 flow units pass directly from source to sink: ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/04481aced8a9d501ae5d785ab654c542ff5497a1.png).

note.ai: 在第一个测试用例中，有 10 个流量单位经过路径 ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/609340f155794c4e9eebcd9cdfa23c73cf982f28.png)，并且有 5 个流量单位直接从源点流向汇点：![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/04481aced8a9d501ae5d785ab654c542ff5497a1.png)。

legend.ai: Emuskald 认为自己是网络流算法大师。现在，他终于完成了迄今为止最精妙的程序：它可以计算无向图中的最大流。该图由 n 个顶点和 m 条边组成。顶点编号为 1 到 n，其中顶点 1 和 n 分别是源点和汇点。
然而，他的最大流算法似乎存在一个小问题：它只能找出每条边上的流量，却无法确定流动方向。请帮助他找出每条边上流量的方向。注意，最终得到的流必须是正确的最大流。
形式化地说，给定一个无向图。对于每条无向边 (ai, bi)，给定其流量 ci。你需要为所有边确定方向，使其满足以下条件：
对于每个顶点 v（1 < v < n），所有入边的 ci 之和等于所有出边的 ci 之和；
编号为 1 的顶点没有入边；

input.ai: 输入的第一行包含两个用空格分隔的整数 n 和 m（2 ≤ n ≤ 2·105，n - 1 ≤ m ≤ 2·105），分别表示图中的顶点数和边数。接下来的 m 行中，每行包含三个用空格分隔的整数 ai、bi 和 ci（1 ≤ ai，bi ≤ n，ai ≠ bi，1 ≤ ci ≤ 104），表示 ai 和 bi 之间存在一条流量为 ci 的无向边。
保证不存在连接同一对顶点的两条边；给定的图是连通的；并且解总是存在。

output.ai: 输出 m 行，每行包含一个整数 di。如果第 i 条边的方向为 ai → bi（流从顶点 ai 流向顶点 bi），则 di 应为 0，否则应为 1。边按照输入中的顺序从 1 到 m 编号。
如果存在多个解，你可以输出其中任意一个。
